en.p: There are two points $\mathrm{A}(-2,\,2)$ and $\mathrm{B}(2,\,2)$ in the coordinate plane. Two points P, Q moving on the figure represented by the points X satisfying

When the length of the figure represented by the set of points Y satisfying $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OY}}=\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OP}}+\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OQ}}$ is $\dfrac{q}{p}\sqrt{3}\pi$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here O is the origin, and $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
